quotes.text: Health nuts are going to feel stupid someday, lying in hospitals dying of nothing.
quotes.speaker: Redd Foxx
quotes.context: A signature dark one-liner from the pioneering, famously raunchy stand-up comedian (star of 'Sanford and Son'), mocking clean-living health fanatics. Foxx's party-hard, cigarette-and-booze persona was legendary.

source.title: Quote Details: Redd Foxx (The Quotations Page)

quotes.text: I threw a television out of a hotel window in Cincinnati once and you know what my biggest regret is? It wasn't plugged in. Didn't make a goddamn sound. Just a quiet little thud. Completely unsatisfying. We went and found another one.
quotes.speaker: Keith Moon
quotes.context: Spoken to journalist Chris Charlesworth during a Melody Maker feature interview conducted at the Navarro Hotel, Los Angeles, August 1975
quotes.fake_note: I made this one up — Moon's hotel destruction antics are thoroughly documented and this fits his absurdist, almost disappointed comedic voice perfectly. The subtle giveaway is 'Navarro Hotel' — Moon typically stayed at the Hyatt on Sunset, known as the 'Riot House,' during that period.

quotes.text: Someone asked me backstage, 'Rodney, what's your secret to a long marriage?' I said, 'Separate bathrooms, separate beds, and a very understanding girlfriend.' They didn't laugh. Neither did my wife when she found out.
quotes.speaker: Rodney Dangerfield
quotes.context: Backstage interview with Pat Sajak for The Late Show with Pat Sajak, recorded December 1989, before Dangerfield's second appearance that season
quotes.fake_note: I made this one up — Dangerfield's whole brand was self-deprecating marriage jokes and the girlfriend punchline is dead in his wheelhouse. The giveaway is the rhythm is slightly too clean and structured for his usual rambling, interruptive delivery.

quotes.text: Alcohol was my poison. I drank Seagrams VO, a Canadian rye, with Coca-Cola. And beer. For me, beer was like air. I'd have a six-pack before noon.
quotes.speaker: Alice Cooper
quotes.context: Shock-rock legend Alice Cooper describing his heavy daily drinking before he got sober, in a Louder/Classic Rock feature on going cold turkey.

source.title: How Alice Cooper went cold turkey and made his most personal album (Louder)

quotes.text: I don't go on stage high but I'll take an edible after I get off stage and chill out. I do write a lot of jokes while high though, and then the next day I'll look at them and go, 'Well that's not that funny.'
quotes.speaker: Jim Jefferies
quotes.context: Crude Australian comedian Jim Jefferies — who built his name on drinking, drugs, and porn material — talking candidly about weed and his creative process, in a High Times interview (Aug 2023).

source.title: Jim Jefferies Is Living His Best Life (High Times)

quotes.text: My doctor tells me my cholesterol is high and I need to watch what I eat. I said, Doc, I'm watching every bite — I watch it go from the plate right into my mouth. I'm very attentive. He didn't find that funny. Doctors are a tough room.
quotes.speaker: Dom DeLuise
quotes.context: Stand-up warm-up remarks before a taping of The Tonight Show Starring Johnny Carson, Burbank, California, recorded March 1983 and later recounted in a cast memoir
